description: This file defines types and functions for managing chat abort operations, including aborting chat runs, broadcasting abort events, and resolving expiration times.

methods.name: isChatStopCommandText
methods.description: Checks if the given text is a chat stop command by delegating to isAbortRequestText.

methods.name: resolveChatRunExpiresAtMs
methods.description: Calculates the expiration timestamp for a chat run based on current time, timeout, and optional grace/min/max durations.

methods.name: broadcastChatAborted
methods.description: Broadcasts an abort message for a chat run to relevant sessions and listeners.

methods.name: abortChatRunById
methods.description: Aborts a specific chat run by its ID, cleaning up associated data and notifying relevant parties.

methods.name: abortChatRunsForSessionKey
methods.description: Aborts all chat runs associated with a specific session key.
